caption: The drawing depicts a decorative archway with intricate patterns, along with a central rectangular panel at the base, all presented on a light yellow background within a rectangular frame. The arch is predominantly red, featuring green and yellow floral and geometric embellishments, including circular and leaf-like motifs. The top center of the arch displays a circular decorative element with a green interior. Directly above the arch, there is an ornate coat of arms containing blue, red, and gold sections, flanked by decorative green supporters and accompanied by a scroll bearing a phrase. Below the coat of arms, and within the archway, a downward-pointing triangle with blue, yellow, and red concentric outlines hangs from an elaborate blue ornamental fixture. The rectangular panel at the base consists of repeated vertical bands in red, gold, and cream, decorated with blue, white, and gold diamond and swirl motifs. The arch rests on a patterned border with a Greek key design in red and gold, above two black rectangular bases. The upper edge of the frame includes a running border of red diamond and dot patterns interspersed with stylized blue and gold motifs. The artist's signature is present in the lower right corner.
title: Wall and Ceiling Decorations
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
